visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with short brown hair, wearing a dark grey t-shirt and a white pearl necklace, stands outdoors in a bright urban plaza. She holds a large grey patterned tote bag and a smartphone, speaking directly to the camera with high energy and frequent hand gestures. (2) The camera transitions to a macro close-up of a white, rectangular electronic device with a circular magnetic ring on its front surface labeled 'qi2'. Hands rotate the device to reveal two integrated white charging cables tucked into the back casing and a small digital display screen. (3) Returning to the medium shot, the woman holds the white power bank in her right hand, pointing to its features while standing against a background of modern high-rise apartments and green trees. The lighting is bright natural daylight, highlighting her expressive facial features and the product's matte texture. (4) Close-up shots demonstrate the functionality of the device, showing the USB-C port at the bottom and the integrated cables being pulled out by fingers. The device is then magnetically attached to the back of a smartphone, which is then propped up on a flat surface using a built-in kickstand. (5) The host appears again in a medium shot, holding both the smartphone and the power bank while waving enthusiastically at the camera. She makes various playful hand signs, including a peace sign, as she concludes her presentation in the well-lit outdoor setting.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 回臺灣之後常常 出門一整天. (2) [Subtitle]: 我覺得包包最必須帶的呢. (3) [Subtitle]: 除了水壺、手機之外 就是行動電源了!. (4) [Subtitle]: 但最近看到太多行動電源爆炸的新聞了. (5) [Subtitle]: 所以在挑行動電源的時候 可以儘量找那種沒有直接充電的 安全度會比較高. (6) [Subtitle]: 我手上這一顆呢 是Lapo他們最新款推出的. (7) [Subtitle]: 有智慧溫控管理晶片 更安全. (8) [Subtitle]: 然後這一台呢 它是六合一的設計 最高可以支援四臺設備同時充電. (9) [Subtitle]: 它有自備兩條10公分的充電線. (10) [Subtitle]: 蘋果或者是安卓手機都可以. (11) [Subtitle]: 單獨使用USB-C充電 可以達到20瓦的快充哦!. (12) [Subtitle]: 它的磁吸部分是13N的強力磁吸. [Variety]: 磁吸 13N. (13) [Subtitle]: 可以達到15瓦快充. (14) [Subtitle]: 我知道很多人可能都會問 可以上飛機嗎? 可以. (15) [Subtitle]: 它的電芯容量是38.5瓦 可以帶上飛機. (16) [Subtitle]: 然後它的側邊呢 還有彩色螢幕顯示電量跟輸出的數據. (17) [Subtitle]: 當你在磁吸充電的時候呢 背後還有一個小支架 可以讓你的手機是立著的. (18) [Subtitle]: 也有指釦環設計方便你拿取. (19) [Subtitle]: 這是最近的新歡行動電源. (20) [Subtitle]: 如果需要的朋友可以一起團購 更划算哦!. (21) [Subtitle]: 歡迎 私訊留言 跟我要連結 給你們優惠. [Slogan]: 私訊留言.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A high-pitched, energetic female voice speaking Traditional Chinese begins narrating over an upbeat, rhythmic electronic pop BGM with a steady 4/4 beat. The vocal delivery is fast-paced and enthusiastic, with clear articulation and positive valence, accompanied by subtle urban outdoor ambience. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' transition sound effect occurs as the speaker introduces the specific brand. The music continues with a bright synthesizer melody. The speaker's pitch variability is high, reflecting excitement while maintaining professional clarity for a product-focused presentation. (3) Subtle digital UI 'pop' and 'click' sound effects are added to punctuate technical features such as magnetic strength and battery capacity. The background music maintains a consistent volume, sitting clearly below the primary vocal track, ensuring a high signal-to-noise ratio. (4) The audio concludes with the speaker inviting the audience to join a group buy, using a rising intonation for emphasis. A final playful 'ding' sound effect marks the end of the promotional segment, with the music fading slightly as the dialogue finishes.
